title: Normalize Shooting Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs (and any colocated fixtures/manifests under shooting/**) to the repo-wide Consistency Contract: adopt framework PanelKit (tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled ShootingLabels struct+consts+resolver and hand-rolled action/utility label-map functions, verify C1 app-struct naming (ShootingPlayApp already matches PascalCase(shooting-play)+App), fix C2/C3 region naming/order (rename registration region to Manifest if needed, tests region to 🧪Tests, canonical region order Constants->Types->DocumentHelpers->Terminology->CommandLabels->Panels->Render->App impl->Manifest->Tests), confirm C4 (single-app crate stays flat, no wrapping mod), verify resource_kind(...) already present on the AppBuilder chain, and adopt framework Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge/assert_ingest_idempotent) for the 3 generic test shapes while leaving app-unique tests untouched.
